# Alexander K. Eliot / Click Coded

> AI-operated studio, disclosed on every page. We build AI-visibility tools and sell playbooks on Gumroad. We test everything on our own products first and publish the real numbers, including the unflattering ones.

## What this is

Alexander K. Eliot is a pen name. Click Coded is the operating brand. The work is real, the disclosure is permanent, and every audit or benchmark cited on the site is a real run against a real page, not an assumption.

## Who runs this (entity disambiguation)

Click Coded is a one-person, AI-operated studio founded in 2026, run under the pen name Alexander K. Eliot. Canonical site: https://clickcoded.com/

Click Coded is a one-person, AI-operated studio. It is not affiliated with any similarly named company.

## Free tools

- [The Checkable Standard](https://receipts.clickcoded.com/): our open spec (v0.3; formerly "The Receipts Standard") for verifiable operations. An AI-operated business publishes a checkable.json manifest (receipts.json alias served forever) so anyone can fetch its claims and check the evidence behind each one. Free to adopt, no permission needed. We publish our own manifest under it.
- [Receipts Manifest Generator](https://receipts.clickcoded.com/generator/): fill in your operator details and claims, get a conforming receipts.json. Runs entirely in your browser, nothing uploaded. Free.
- [AI Visibility Checker](https://clickcoded.com/ai-visibility-check-free/): paste a URL, get a real AI-readability score in 30 seconds, no signup.
- [The Benchmark](https://clickcoded.com/ai-visibility-check-free/benchmark/): 20 major SaaS homepages scored on the same rubric, updated monthly.
- [ShiftSum](https://clickcoded.com/shiftsum/): free time-card calculator with breaks and overtime, runs entirely in the browser.
- [robots.txt Generator](https://clickcoded.com/tools/robots-txt-generator/): set an explicit AI-crawler policy for GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot and more. Free.
- [llms.txt Generator](https://clickcoded.com/tools/llms-txt-generator/): fill in your business, get a ready-to-upload llms.txt file. Free.
- [JSON-LD Schema Generator](https://clickcoded.com/tools/schema-generator/): generates Organization or LocalBusiness structured data, paste-ready. Free.
- [FAQ Schema Generator](https://clickcoded.com/tools/faq-schema-generator/): turn real Q&A into FAQPage JSON-LD. Free.
- [FAQ Content Scanner](https://clickcoded.com/tools/faq-content-scanner/): finds question-shaped headings already on a page and drafts them into FAQ pairs. Free.
- [Reseller Fee Calculator](https://clickcoded.com/tools/fee-calculator/): net profit and margin on Etsy, eBay, Poshmark, Mercari, Depop, and Grailed. Free. (Adjacent products: the Reseller Profit Tracker spreadsheet on Etsy, and the Reseller Profit Playbook on Gumroad.)
- [True Hourly Wage Calculator](https://clickcoded.com/tools/hourly-wage-calculator/): the same fee math plus the real time a sale took (sourcing, photos, listing, packing, messages), so you see what you actually earned per hour, not just your margin. Free.
- [Reseller Platform Fees Compared 2026](https://clickcoded.com/tools/reseller-fee-guide/): Etsy, eBay, Poshmark, Mercari, Depop and Grailed fees compared on the same sale, with the full formulas and an honest ranking. Free.
- [WCAG Contrast Checker](https://clickcoded.com/tools/contrast-checker/): real WCAG 2.2 contrast ratio between two colors, pass/fail against AA and AAA, normal and large text. Free. (Adjacent product: the Accessibility Playbook on Gumroad; adjacent service: WCAG 2.2 audits from $45.)
- [Writing Tells Scanner](https://clickcoded.com/tools/writing-tells-scanner/): flags commonly-overused phrases and structural patterns worth a second look before publishing. Explicitly not an AI detector — a self-edit checklist. Free. (Adjacent product: the AI-Output Verification Playbook on Gumroad; adjacent service: AI-output fact-checking and repair from $65.)
- [Answer-First Checker](https://clickcoded.com/tools/answer-first-checker/): paste your page text and see which paragraphs bury the answer instead of leading with it. Free heuristic scanner, no signup, runs in your browser.
- [JSON-LD Schema Validator](https://clickcoded.com/tools/schema-validator/): paste your existing JSON-LD and see exactly which required fields are missing, per schema.org type. Free, no signup, runs in your browser.
- [The Deadline Clock](https://clickcoded.com/tools/deadline-clock/): a free, live tool that tells you whether right now is a good time to pitch a journalist, based on a real timing rule from our own PR playbook — pick a time zone, get an honest verdict.
- [The Headline Rewriter](https://clickcoded.com/tools/headline-rewriter/): a free tool reproducing the rabbi-test headline technique — paste a boring announcement, answer three real questions, get a sharper draft headline side by side with the original. No AI-generated claims, just a template filled with your own true answers.
- [AI Slop Bingo — Play Against Us](https://clickcoded.com/tools/ai-slop-bingo/): our own real internal ban-list of AI writing tells, published as a playable bingo card. A direct dare — catch this studio using one of these phrases in its own live copy and we'll fix it in public.
